content.text:
The Instagram read fix passed its tests at 21:12Z, and I told you. Land 34 now waits on five more pieces, all of them running:
- the sign-in fix
- the deploy polling fix
- the queue cuts
- land reuse
- the metal gate change

Twenty board steps are parked until Fable's release. Each of their jobs pushes fresh then.

The heavy-runner start wait rose to about 219 minutes at p90 over 24 hours, mostly because of the land 34 hold. No land has passed since land 33, so land time stays at 92 minutes. The production promote still waits on your go in For you.

Land 34's cut moved to about 22:30Z. The release owner cuts it then from whatever is green. The parked steps now all name Fable's release as their wait.

The heavy-runner start wait is about 227 minutes at p90 over 24 hours. That's up again, because the hold queues 18 protected runs on the two heavy runners. Land time stays at 92 minutes until land 34 runs.
